chunks: We raised (many more) generations and prolonged their lives. You did not live with the people of Midian, nor recited to them Our revelations; but We kept on sending messengers.
ai.seo_question: Why did Prophet Muhammad not live among the people of Midian?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Hud clarifies that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was not a resident of Midian nor did he recite the Quran to its people directly, as God had already raised previous generations and prolonged their lifespans before sending His messengers. In Shia exegesis, this distinction underscores the unique temporal and spiritual station of the Prophet, separating his specific mission from the historical cycles of earlier prophets like Jethro (Shu'ayb). It highlights that while the message is consistent, the divine timing and the specific audience for each messenger are distinct aspects of God's wisdom.
